title: Canonical ringed sequence site for the coefficient quotient tower
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its valuation ring and uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$ [def-pc-scheme]. Use its small pro-etale site $\mathcal V$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $B_n$ for the actual quotient coefficient sheaves and their quotient transitions [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], and $A=\varprojlim B_n$ for the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with completion projections [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Define the ringed sequence site on $\mathbf N\times\mathcal V$ (index $n$ denotes exponent $n+1$): a sieve covers $(n,U)$ exactly when its vertical slice at $n$ covers $U$. The ring sheaf has value $B_n(U)$ and horizontal restrictions the actual quotient maps. Its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] give the ringed-site realization of strict quotient-semilinear systems; take their ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Evaluation $e_n$ is the actual exact inverse image along the nth vertical inclusion, with its coefficient identification, actual quotient-semilinear transition maps and unchanged underlying abelian section objects. A derived system is normalized when the scalar-extension adjuncts of its successive transitions are isomorphisms [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. Restricting each component along $A\to B_n$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] gives an exact functor $U$ to ordinary towers of $A$-modules, with transitions the actual underlying section maps. Define $\mathcal L=R\varprojlim\circ D(U)$ using total derived inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Its canonical projections $\mathcal L\to\operatorname{Res}_n e_n$ are the actual limit-cone projections on every simultaneous K-injective tower, transported by the exact evaluation/localization comparison. Use the recorded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the sequence ringed site and each fiber; use the underlying total derived section functor of [def-coef-hom-zero-cycle-class] on integral and finite coefficients. These are named canonical constructions and their sectionwise or representative characterizations, not arbitrary functors or projection maps.

source.place: Tag 0941, the ringed sequence site and total derived inverse limit; Tags 06YY and 07A6 for the actual scalar restrictions and extensions; injectives.tex Tag 079P for the representative-normalized projections. Construction used in proof steps 1-4 of lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus.

proof.text: Verify the topology axioms on vertical slices: the top sieve is covering, a vertical pullback is contained in the slice of a product pullback, and transitivity follows by testing the local condition on vertical arrows. For the sheaf condition glue on the vertical slice and use separatedness on pullback covers to check the horizontal arrows. Apply this criterion to the uncurried quotient-ring tower.

The vertical inclusion preserves covers and compatible families, hence is continuous by Mathlib. Uncurrying identifies its ring sheaf with the recorded finite ring. The module pushforward preserves finite limits after forgetting to abelian presheaves, and finite colimits after forgetting to abelian sheaves using cocontinuity. Forgetful functors reflect these properties. Addition and the abelian-section identities are checked sectionwise.

Prove the horizontal ring comparison using uncurrying and functoriality of the actual quotient tower. Compose the completed coefficient limit projections with the evaluation ring identifications; the limit cone equations give compatibility. Assemble the module pushforwards into a strict tower with these completed-linear horizontal maps. Presheaf identity, composition and naturality give the functor equations. Prove uniqueness by the prescribed component objects and heterogeneous equality on every section. The restriction characterization gives its evaluated functor equality. Exactness is checked at each tower level using exact scalar restriction, and additivity follows from left exactness.

Apply the independent-universe module-sheaf Grothendieck theorem [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] to the completed ring. For diagrams, the evaluation left adjoints carry a separator to a separating family: apply the evaluation adjunction and separator extensionality at each object. Their coproduct is a separator; pointwise colimits and AB5 yield a Grothendieck diagram category. Use AsSmall and equivalence transport for the countable index category, then the K-injective instance. Prove additivity of inverse limit by composing with all limit projections.

Construct the derived projection using rightDerivedDesc from the termwise limit projection followed by the inverse factorization for exact evaluation. On a K-injective representative, cancel the invertible derived unit and use the quotient-to-derived comparison identities to obtain exactly the required normalization. For uniqueness, transport equality from K-injective representatives to every object through exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isKInjective and naturality. Subsequent functors use the unchanged canonical definitions.

proof_origin.note: V4, 2026-10-19: all 15 original named theorem holes are proved in Lean. The implemented route uses vertical slices, actual quotient and completed-limit projections, componentwise exactness, the Grothendieck diagram category and the right-derived universal property. Existing public statements and definitions are unchanged.

reviewed_lean.note: Previous RETURN (24d3ed97d8f8) finding resolved: the new fiber_transition field states that, for normalized M,N and n<=m, the transition of the internal Hom (in adjoint form, under fiberHom at m and n) equals F_{mn}(fiberHom_m) then c_{m,n} then RHom_{B_n}(alpha_M^-1, alpha_N). c_{m,n} is the transpose of reduced evaluation along the recorded derivedChangeOfRingsIndependentCoefficients for B_m->B_n. The adjunction is pinned by ordinary_unit (sheafified 1⊗x) and unit_model; D.tensor is pinned by the pure-tensor tensor_model on K-flats. alpha is the actual transition adjoint, and its invertibility follows from the normalization criterion by Yoneda. The other changes only package existing formulas, verbatim: CoefficientScalarTensorGenerators, CoefficientTensorUncurryModel, CoefficientGlobalLimitModel. The commit touches only its 11 files. Statement verbatim; all 92 declarations listed; docstrings with source and blueprint everywhere; no hollow data; every sorry is a standalone theorem. nt_compile --json on all 5 modules: exit 0, no messages (calculus 33.8 s, tensor-Hom 14.8 s, others under 28 s).
